data.name: Aeisha
data.gender_notes: Aeisha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is responsible for managing the household and nurturing the family in accordance with Islamic teachings. The name Aeisha carries the meaning “Lady of the house” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aeisha usually hope their child will grow to embody lady of the house and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of dedication, nurturing, and love within the Islamic community.
data.etymology: Aeisha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lady of the house.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aeisha total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: عايشة
in_arabic.meaning: حياة، عيش، سعادة، الراحة، والهناء في الحياة
in_arabic.long_meaning: عايشة هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، ويعني الحياة، العيش، السعادة، الراحة، والهناء في الحياة. هذا الاسم ذو أصول عربية، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة النساء آية 25، 'وَيعيشونَ في رِضوانِ اللهِ تَعالى'، كما ورد في الحديث النبوي الشريف، 'عايشة بنت أبي بكر الصديق رضي الله عنهم'. يتميز هذا الاسم بأهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرتبط بالحياة الطيبة والسعيدة.

in_urdu.name: عائشہ
in_urdu.meaning: زندگی، آرام، سکھ، خوشحالی اور اچھے حالات
in_urdu.long_meaning: عائشہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے زندگی، آرام، سکھ، خوشحالی اور اچھے حالات۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں سورة النساء آية ۲۵ میں ذکر ہوا ہے، 'وَيَعِيشُونَ فِي رِضْوَانِ اللّهِ تَعَالَى'، اور حدیث نبوی شریف میں 'عائشہ بنت ابی بکر الصدیق رضی اللہ عنہم' کے طور پر آیا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں خاصی اہمیت رکھتا ہے، جو اچھی اور سعید زندگی کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: आइशा
in_hindi.meaning: जीवन, सुख, शांति, खुशी और अच्छे हालात
in_hindi.long_meaning: आइशा एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है जीवन, सुख, शांति, खुशी और अच्छे हालात। यह नाम कुरआन में सूरत अन-निसा आयत २५ में 'और वे अल्लाह की رضा में रहते हैं' के रूप में उल्लेखित है, और हदीस में 'आइशा बिन्त अबी बकर सिद्दीق رضی اللہ عنہم' के रूप में आया है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में विशेष महत्व रखता है, जो सुखी और अच्छी जिंदगी की ओर संकेत करता है।

in_pashto.name: عايشہ
in_pashto.meaning: ژوند، ارام، خوښي، سعادت او ښه حالت

in_english.name: Aeisha
in_english.meaning: Alive, prosperous, happy, well-lived life and peaceful existence
in_english.long_meaning: Aeisha is a female given name of Arabic origin, meaning 'alive', 'prosperous', 'happy', and signifying a 'well-lived life' and 'peaceful existence'. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'A-Y-Sh' (ع-ي-ش), this name has a strong Quranic background, mentioned in Surah An-Nisa, Verse 25, and linked to Aisha bint Abi Bakr, a prominent companion of Prophet Muhammad. The name holds significant spiritual and cultural importance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing a life of happiness, comfort, and divine pleasure.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aisha holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic world and beyond. Aisha bint Abi Bakr (R.A.), the third wife of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), is one of the most revered and beloved figures in Islam. Her name is synonymous with female intellectualism, courage, and grace. Aisha was an accomplished scholar, proficient in sciences, and had a profound knowledge of Islamic jurisprudence. Her contributions to Islamic scholarship and her role as a mother, wife, and a leader to the Islamic community have left a lasting impact on the Muslim world.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the name Aisha holds deep spiritual significance, representing a pious and devout woman who upholds Islamic values in her personal and family life. Aisha bint Abu Bakr (R.A.) is known for her unwavering commitment to Islam and her service to her community, embodying the Islamic ideal of a virtuous wife, mother, and scholar. Additionally, many Sufi and mystic traditions view Aisha (R.A.) as a spiritual guide and role model for women, emphasizing her connection to the divine and her inner spiritual strengths.
